title: Learning to Cook Cantonese Food with My Grandma

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hey Grandma, I'm live-streaming our cooking session for my channel.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Live-streaming? Like a creek? I thought we were in the kitchen.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Streaming means broadcasting online. People watch through their phones.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Watch through phones? Why don't they just come over? I have extra chairs.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: They can't come over. They're subscribers. Digital followers.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Followers? Like disciples? I only follow Buddha and my ancestors.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: It's the same concept. They follow my content religiously.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Religiously? For cooking? You should follow recipes religiously, not strangers.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: The algorithm promotes my videos. It's how I get reach.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Algorithm? Is that a new spice? I have star anise and ginger.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Algorithm is the system that decides who sees what online.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: System? Like feng shui? I arrange my kitchen for good energy, not systems.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Feng shui is old school. Digital energy is what matters now.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Digital energy? Qi is qi. It doesn't need a phone.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Qi doesn't pay bills. Ad revenue does.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Ad revenue? From cooking? I cook for family, not advertisements.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Family is content. The most engaging genre.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Genre? Like in a library? Cooking is life, not a category.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Everything is a category now. Tag it. Algorithm it.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Tag? Like price tags? I don't put prices on my love.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Tags are metadata. Keywords. Search terms.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Keywords? I use words to communicate, not to search.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Search is how people find you. SEO is everything.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: SEO? Like CEO? I don't run a company.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: SEO means Search Engine Optimization. Being findable.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Findable? I'm right here. In my kitchen. For sixty years.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Offline existence doesn't count. You need digital presence.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Presence? I am present. That's enough.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Not enough. You need a profile. A brand.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Brand? Like cattle? I am not livestock!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Brand means image. How the world sees you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: The world sees me through my cooking. Not through a screen.
